question: What honor will Priyanka Chopra Jonas receive at the Gold House Gala 2025?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Global Vanguard Honour**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Priyanka Chopra Jonas to be honoured at Gold House Gala 2025.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Priyanka Chopra Jonas** will receive the **inaugural Global Vanguard Honour** at the **Gold House Gala 2025**.

 
 
• 
 
The award is for her **25-year career** bridging **Asian Pacific** and **Western cultures**.

 
 
• 
 
Priyanka is recognized for her notable roles in both **Bollywood and Hollywood**, including movies like:

 
 
• 
 
**Krrish**

 
 
• 
 
**Bajirao Mastani**

 
 
• 
 
**Barfi**

 
 
• 
 
**Don**

 
 
• 
 
**Citadel**

 
 
• 
 
**Love Again**

 
 
 
 
• 
 
The **Gold Gala** is the **premier celebration of Asian Pacific and multicultural excellence**.
